description: This file defines a static internal class 'NetworkingInstruments' that creates and manages metrics counters for network socket events, specifically counting opened and closed sockets, with methods to update these counters based on socket connection directions.

classes.name: NetworkingInstruments
classes.description: Static internal class responsible for tracking network socket open and close events via metrics counters.

methods.name: OnOpenedSocket
methods.description: Increments the 'opened sockets' counter with the connection direction.

methods.name: OnClosedSocket
methods.description: Increments the 'closed sockets' counter with the connection direction.
